title: backlog check warns of a goal that names a kb path no touch covers
goal: backlog.py check warns, for an open item whose goal names a kb/ path or directory (a path-shaped token such as kb/_self/reports/) that none of its touches covers, naming the item and the path; an item whose touches cover every such path gets no warning. Answers the SP-sz5fbvqn retrospective: ST-eegqfkah's goal named a report under kb/_self/reports/ but its touches held no reports path, found only at dispatch.

run: import tempfile,subprocess,sys,os;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.makedirs(d+'/kb/_self/backlog');R=os.getcwd()+'/_tools/backlog.py';r=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,R,'--root',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True);i=r('new','story','--title','t','--goal','writes a report under kb/_self/reports/ for the sprint','--touch','_tools/x.py','--check','python3 -c pass').stdout.split()[2];p=r('check');w=[l for l in (p.stdout+p.stderr).splitlines() if i in l and 'kb/_self/reports/' in l and 'touch' in l.lower()];print('check exit',p.returncode,'| warning naming the uncovered goal path:',w or 'none');sys.exit(0 if w else 1)

gates.question: When does a touches glob cover a kb path the goal names?
options: overlap: a file inside a touched directory glob, a touch inside a named directory, or the same path
exact: only a touch naming the same path or glob
gates.recommendation: overlap: a file inside a touched directory glob, a touch inside a named directory, or the same path

gates.question: Does the goal path warning leave out a sprint's goal research story, whose goal restates the sprint goal and whose touches are kb content?
options: leave out: no warning for a goal research story
warn: judge it like any other item
gates.recommendation: leave out: no warning for a goal research story
